definitions.page_p95: HTTP request duration; browser rendering is not measured
definitions.ack_per_second: unique ACK delta between offline end and replay end divided by replay duration
definitions.audit_due: live usages whose next_check_at is due, including periodic rechecks
definitions.writer_hold: diagnostic acquisition to commit/rollback invocation, excluding physical commit I/O
definitions.aggregate: median of per-run values in pairs with both environment checks passing; not pooled request P95

environment_rules.memory_counter_source: vm_stat Swapins/Swapouts times reported page size; Pageins/Pageouts recorded separately
